description: Map of Slack functions the workflow engine can use. The AI/converger reads the AVAILABLE subset (implemented AND the client's token grants requiredScopes) so it only proposes Slack actions that genuinely work for that client. To add a capability: add an entry here, then implement its handler in index.js and flip `implemented` to true. To restrict a client, that follows automatically from the scopes their bot token was granted.

actions.label: Post a message to a channel
actions.description: Post a message to a public or private channel the bot can access.

config.hint: Message text; omit to use the prior step output

actions.label: Direct-message a user
actions.description: Send a direct message to a single user (opens a DM conversation, then posts).

config.hint: Slack user ID (U…); resolve from email if needed

actions.label: Reply in a thread
actions.description: Post a threaded reply under an existing message.

actions.label: Add an emoji reaction
actions.description: React to a message with an emoji.

config.hint: Emoji name without colons, e.g. white_check_mark

actions.label: Upload a file
actions.description: Upload a file (or snippet) to one or more channels.

config.hint: File contents (text) or a path/URL the handler resolves
